replication.target_description: Requested best-unimodal versus averaged-predicted comparison could not be securely identified in the supplied main report. Fig. 3B compares empirical audiovisual with best unimodal; section 3.3 compares empirical with MLE-predicted audiovisual parameters. Neither is the stated contrast.

notes: Identity verified from supplied canonical PMC full-report parse: title Integration of audiovisual spatial signals is not consistent with maximum likelihood estimation; authors David Meijer, Sebastijan Veselič, Carmelo Calafiore, Uta Noppeney; Cortex 119:74–88 (2019); DOI 10.1016/j.cortex.2019.03.026. Methods, Results, Discussion and references are present; supplementary DOCX is linked but not supplied. No PDF was supplied, so page-10 layout could not be inspected. Original and unassigned fields are placeholders only. Target correspondence is unresolved: no study_r is provided, and the page-10 locator has no page mapping in this HTML parse. Candidate tests are Fig. 3B empirical AV versus best unisensory (24 significant individual reductions), and section 3.3 empirical versus MLE-predicted AV (t(35)=.33, p=.37, BF01=4.24, dz=.06). Neither compares best unisensory with an averaged predicted condition. Candidate common main-experiment N is explicitly 36 participants (all final datasets included); seven earlier exclusions/withdrawals were replaced, and section 3.2 documents trial exclusions. This common N is retained only as candidate evidence, not assigned to an unresolved target. No N is inferred from df or summed. Discussion gives a mixed overall MLE verdict (variance reduction consistent, visual weights inconsistent), but this is not securely a verdict for the requested contrast.
